idea-plugin.name: MCP Server Extension
idea-plugin.description:
Extends the JetBrains MCP Server with IDE surfaces the built-in tools do not cover. Works with any MCP client: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Junie and others. Everything is prefixed with rider_; build, debugger, terminal, refactorings and search stay with the built-in tools, and the tool descriptions point agents to them.

  • Test runner: scoped runs by filter/class/method, structured results with stack traces, rerun failed
  • Database consoles: open consoles and table tabs, scripts with GO batches, background jobs with PRINT/RAISERROR progress, read-only guard, secret masking, CSV/JSON export, results of user-run scripts
  • Tool windows: any panel as text (Run, Debug app console, Build, Problems, TODO, Endpoints, Services)
  • IDE state and context: indexing/busy, cursor, selection, open editors, unsaved files, bookmarks
  • Run configurations: create, clone with args/env, update, delete
  • NuGet, Publish, workspace configuration: add/remove/restore packages, Publish output and RID/publishDir (Rider only)
  • Agent permissions: Tools → Configure Agent Permissions lets connected agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) call read-only or all IDE tools without a prompt; read-only tools declare readOnlyHint
  • Solution Wide Analysis error counts, inspection settings, IDE-managed processes, live dotTrace/dotMemory sessions, cache invalidation

Requires 2026.2+. Supports Rider and RustRover (Rider-only tools such as NuGet, Publish, dotTrace/dotMemory, SWEA are unavailable in RustRover).

action.description: Let AI agents connected to the IDE MCP server call its tools without a prompt
